mentions.name: Faultsense
mentions.description: Faultsense is an open source tool that runs end-to-end tests for web apps in production through actual user sessions, showing exactly which browser session cohorts are having issues.
mentions.problem: E2e tests don't normally run in production through real user sessions, making it hard to know what browser session cohorts are having issues.
mentions.source_excerpt: What if your web apps e2e tests ran in production through actual user sessions? Know exactly what browser session cohorts are having issues. Open source, https://github.com/Faultsense/faultsense-agent
